J4 GPS
1 NC/RST  2 NC/PPS
3 NC/WAKE  4 RX
5 TX  6 BACKUP
7 POWER  8 GND
J8 BAT: 1 + / 2 GND. J12 LTO: 1 BAT / 2 MID / 3 GND / 4 NC.
Cable supplies power/GND; metal stands are for shield contact.
Keep all four foil contacts clean. Use metal DIN433 M3 washers.
No SH1 frame/lid. Continuous foil: no slots or cut-out letters.
M3 holes 3.2mm / washer OD6 / PCB 1.52mm / foil one face
Before USB: REMOVE J11. Refit only after USB is disconnected.
Disconnect solar + battery + USB before disassembly.
LOGIC above: NiceNano + HT-RA62 + RTC + watchdog
J101 <-> J201: cable pins 1:1; route around screen edge.
1/3/5/7 FILTER_OUT   all even GND   9 BAT   11 MODE
COPPER SIDE DOWN / GND CONTACT OD6
Full assembly instructions / cable / variants: project docs.
Metal washers DIN433 3.2 x 6 x 0.5mm; 5 per corner.
Below: stand 18mm + washer. Above: washer + stand 15mm.
RTC: CR2032 primary cell. D3 CHARGE / D4 DONE on POWER.
GPS: J4 Heltec T114 pinout; power enable nRF P0.24.
USB / firmware: REMOVE J11. ISP J10 is on LOGIC.
LTO 2S: fit BAL1/BAL2; omit COLD. R56 0R
Na-ion without COLD: omit cold parts; R56 0R
Na-ion 1S: fit COLD; omit BAL1/BAL2. R56 1.8R
